user.description: Add a wall display by its IP address or host name. The password is only needed if one is set on the display.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the display, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.password: Leave empty if the display has no password.

reconfigure.description: Change the address or the password of the display.

reauth_confirm.description: The display at {host} rejected the password. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: The display does not answer. Check the address and that it is switched on.
error.invalid_auth: The display needs a password, or the password is wrong.
error.not_wall_display: This device is not a wall display.

abort.already_configured: This display is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different display.

data_description.cache_days: A cached clip is deleted from the display when it was not played for this many days.

play_failed.message: The display could not play the clip: {error}

fetch_failed.message: The audio could not be downloaded: {error}

clip_too_large.message: The audio is larger than 20 MB.

set_failed.message: The setting could not be changed: {error}

clear_failed.message: The clips could not be deleted: {error}

unsupported_media.message: Only text to speech, media sources and http(s) URLs can be played, not {media_id}.
